pdk: gf180mcuD (open_pdks 1.0.605, commit f6eeac7d) in both images; gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0

physical.routing_layers: Signal routing Metal2-Metal5 (RT_MAX_LAYER=Metal5), cell rails Metal1, PDN Metal4 vertical straps only (PDN_MULTILAYER=false); Metal5 carries signal routing in this macro. The Metal1-Metal4 variant that keeps Metal5 free for MIM decap is recorded under variants.
physical.memory: No SRAM macro: the RTL storage is register arrays (async/sync FIFOs 4.4 kbit, capture/playback 2 x 32 x 24 bit) with dual-clock or combinational reads that single-port gf180mcu_fd_ip_sram macros cannot serve without clock muxing. Implemented in flops inside the digital+memory allocation.

reset_safety.regfile_fields: analog_cfg/debug_cfg at reset defaults; island_en, ATB, receiver and observation enables, ENABLE, MODE8 0; MISO 0 and MISO_OE 0 with CS_N high

timing.method: OpenSTA on the routed netlist with OpenRCX SPEF (nom RC at tt, max RC at ss, min RC at ff), propagated CTS clocks, integration/pt_digital_macro.sdc at its targets. fmax_est = 1/(T - WNS) over paths launched and captured by the same clock.
timing.envelope_note: No Liberty exists inside the narrow envelope (22-32 C, 3.15-3.35 V). The nearest characterized corners are tt_025C_3v30 (inside), ss_125C_3v00 / ss_n40C_3v00 and ff_n40C_3v60 / ff_125C_3v60 (outside, pessimistic in both directions).
timing.hold: met at every clock and corner (worst hold slack in sta-report.json)
timing.crossings_after_exceptions: Remaining timed clock-to-clock paths are the bounded categories of the SDC (Gray pointers, FIFO storage reads, held handshake registers) plus one undocumented crossing: ref-domain cal_busy ORed combinationally into the rf_mute output (rftx-constrained). See open_risks.

safe.note: Post-route netlist: 101 snapshots taken while reset is asserted (RESET_N+POR, RESET_N alone, POR alone, RESET_N mid-write): 0 violations; analog_cfg/debug_cfg at declared defaults, island_en/island_on/ATB/receiver/observation enables 0, D2H OE 0, no X/Z on any control output (wire_tx_data/rf_tx_sample are X with valid=0: FIFO storage has no reset).

clean.note: Magic DRC 0, KLayout DRC 0 (LibreLane GDS and the analog-image Magic 8.3.678 export, which XORs to 0 against it), Netgen LVS 0 errors, OpenROAD and KLayout antenna 0. Gate-level simulation of the post-route netlist matches the RTL and the register model. Timing does NOT meet the clock targets at ss (and several at tt); performance_vs_target records it (block-deliverables: performance does not gate freeze).

observable.note: ID/ABI/map hash, POR vs RESET_N cause flags, island power-good and fault status, core status and frequency-counter lock/count read over SPI on the post-route netlist.

safe.note: Digital half passes (D2H OE=0 and data 0 at reset on the netlist; H2D inputs only capture). Pad half (provider bi_24t/in_c with powered peer and unpowered die, RESET_N weak pull-down PD=1 on in_c) is an assembly/pads-stage check not run here.

clean.note: pt_host_link is inside the clean macro; the provider pad cells and their hookup at the ring are not assembled or checked yet (freeze stage 2/4).

observable.note: Core status over SPI shows frame-receiver lock / rx fault; D2H looped to H2D locks in DDR, SDR and reduced-rate SDR on the post-route netlist; DBG_OBS host_rx_clk_div.

fallback.note: debug.host_link.mode 1/2 (SDR, reduced-rate SDR) implemented and exercised in the netlist loopback; SPI capture/playback memory is the last route.

hostio.partition: Provider gf180mcu_fd_io cells own pads/ESD/drive/receivers: bi_24t at the bidir sites (SPI, H2D, D2H), in_c at rst_n_pad (RESET_N, PD=1 weak pull-down), clk_pad (in_s in the template) needs the provider-permitted substitution to bi_24t for D2H[0]. Ours (in the hardened macro, rtl/pt_host_link.sv): DDR/SDR capture on H2D_CLK, pair FIFO into the core host word clock, D2H launch, centre-aligned forwarded D2H_CLK (word/2 toggle on the falling edge in DDR, gated inverted word clock in SDR), d2h_enable gating, drive/slew controls to the pads.

pad_toggle_screen.note: Liberty-only eye budget (see hostio_pad_screen.py); the pads alone allow roughly 178 MHz DDR out / 191 MHz DDR in (CMOS receiver, CS=0) at ss 2.97 V; Schmitt inputs (CS=1, in_s) drop to ~148 MHz. Not a qualification.

hostio.verdict: 156.25 MHz DDR is NOT reachable: the pads would allow about 150-180 MHz DDR, but the standard-cell transport (framer, FIFO read muxes) closes only at the host word clock above; the DDR pin clock is half of it.
hostio.reduced_rate_proposal: Tapeout-plan host-link fallback: SDR (mode 1) or reduced-rate SDR (mode 2) with the host word clock at or below the worst-corner fmax (H2D_CLK = D2H_CLK = word clock), or DDR with the pin clock at half of it. Full rate needs a 2-word-wide transport and pipelined FIFO reads (open RTL item).

performance_vs_target.note: 1800 x 1800 um; 1650 x 1650 um failed detailed placement after antenna repair and the 1580 x 1580 um floorplan failed detailed placement (utilization ~0.67-0.71).

decisions: Memory: no gf180mcu_fd_ip_sram macro. The RTL storage is register arrays with dual-clock (async FIFO) or combinational reads; single-port synchronous SRAMs cannot serve them without clock muxing. Flop storage (~11.3k sequential cells total) is inside the macro. Item 9 MIM-over-SRAM therefore does not apply.

Metal5: the primary macro routes on Metal1-Metal5 with Metal4-only PDN straps (PDN_MULTILAYER false). A Metal1-Metal4 variant (Metal5 free for MIM) of the same netlist and floorplan also routed with DRC 0 and LVS 0 but left 2 antenna violations and ~45 % worse tt setup slack (variants.metal4_only); at 1650 x 1650 um the Metal4-only route did not converge (11371 GRT overflows).
Timing targets kept at the specification rates; closure is not claimed. fmax per clock/corner recorded.
Port buffering: LibreLane input/output port buffers enabled (disabling output buffers crashed TritonCTS).

Signoff SDC adds three exceptions to the PnR SDC (CS_N->MISO and CS_N->register data false paths, forwarded D2H_CLK unconstrained, bounded crossings restricted to the reader clock); see sdc.pnr vs sdc.signoff.
open_risks: Timing: at ss_125C/3.0 V (outside the envelope) every fast clock misses its target by 2-5x; at tt the host word, wired and RF sample clocks also miss. Silicon must run reduced clocks or the RTL needs pipelining (FIFO read muxes over a 1.8 mm die, stream framer, regfile commit path).
Max slew/cap violations remain (hundreds at tt, ~1.7k at ss) on the large flop-FIFO nets.
Undocumented CDC: rf_mute = cal_busy (ref domain) OR stream mute (rftx). Level to analog, but should be resynchronized or documented.
Area 3.24 mm2 against the 2.5 mm2 digital+memory allocation.
pt_clocktree_slow cfg_det_en/cfg_det_div have no register field (strapped in pt_chip).
D2H[0] at clk_pad needs the in_s -> bi_24t cell substitution; RESET_N PD=1 tie and pad-level safe tests belong to the pad/assembly stage.
GLS is zero-delay functional (no SDF); timing is covered by STA only.
Regfile formal proof was not re-run here on the final map (0x5A1F); the register-file agent owns it.
